description:
Elixir reserves none of if/case/cond/with/receive/quote/unquote; they parse as ordinary calls, so every call spelling works: quote(do: 1), if(x, do: a, else: b), if x, do: a, case(x, do: (...)). fz lexes the seven as keyword tokens (parser/lexer.rs:719-728, token_payload.rs:74-75,186-187), and each has its own front-door parser (frontdoor.rs:1044-1430: parse_if/case/cond/with/receive/quote/unquote_expr), which accepts only some spellings: quote(do: 1 + 0) fails with 'expected do, got LParen', and if(true, do: 1, else: 2) and case(1, do: ...) fail with 'expected ), got Comma'. All of them already emit ordinary call nodes.

Fix:
1. One do-block parser, as in Elixir: do ... end becomes [do: ..., else: ..., after: ...], and each section is a block or a list of a -> b clauses. attach_trailing_do (frontdoor.rs:1597) uses it for every call, so user macros get else blocks too.
2. The seven words lex as identifiers, and every spelling goes through the generic call paths (finish_call, parse_no_parens_args, attach_trailing_do).
3. Shape rules (case needs -> clauses, if needs do) move to decode, which already turns these nodes into Expr, with clear errors.
fn/do/end/else/after/when/not/and/or/in stay reserved, as in Elixir.

Removed: the seven per-form parsers, their seven Tok variants and token_payload entries, and their arms in the expression-prefix match (frontdoor.rs:750-760).

Done when: a new fixture runs quote/if/case/cond/with in all three spellings and asserts equal values (fails first); a user macro with do ... else ... end receives both sections; the quote of each spelling is identical; every existing fixture stays green. Proposal: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-p8p.28-29.html (approved 2026-09-26). One commit.
title: Special forms are ordinary calls, with one do-block parser
